item.title: Ente Community Discord Nov 10, 2026 - 27 messages in 6 channels
item.description:

#photos

#ensu

Five messages from 3 participants discussed voice conversation, system-wide dictation, local AI models, and possible AI-assisted Tauri contributions. A Windows user also asked how to make Ensu use a dedicated GPU instead of the CPU.

#space

Four messages from 2 participants focused on how Space may be monetized and whether its storage could eventually draw from overall Ente storage. A related Discord message was shared.

#off-topic

Three messages exchanged opinions about short articles, reading habits, and the usefulness of paragraphs.

#auth

A single message shared the ente-auth-extension GitHub project, described as an independently created extension.

#memes

Two participants shared one attachment each.
